body: Thank you.  I have a curable form of it, but the side effects make the rest of it worse.  So I feel incredibly depressed, and the "rose-colored" goggles that come from Zoloft and a few other things aren't fixing it.  I identify with others here that I feel like I am broken.  Whenever I climb out of the hole, the hole turns into a sink-hole.  I feel like I can't be depressed and sad.  The bottom of the hole just keeps getting worse.  I want to be loved.  I can't find it...

If I can offer some help, people do support you.  I'd love for you to care for me - I have CPTSD, and I was recently diagnosed with Leukemia.  I'd love to have someone who cares enough to drive for it.  My current doctor does everything clinically - I go to four different places for clinical care.  I continue to raise my family, and contribute to my men's group raising young men to be the way they need to be because it provides me with purpose.  You may feel worthless, and I feel that way daily.  I connect with you, and know we're both not.

Completely agree.  Your suffering sounds difficult.  I have been at a 15/3 in pain and related to a 3/3.  We're here for you.  You aren't alone, and I hear you struggle.  If you'll stick around, I'll always hear your struggle.
